tonight.headline: Up after Thursday; Wilson ruled out on the bench, nothing to set
body: Bad news first, and it is on the bench: Garrett Wilson was ruled OUT on Friday (concussion; ESPN/NY Post 6 Nov), and George Pickens finished a week of limited practices with the hamstring — no Friday designation was retrievable, ESPN still lists him questionable.

Bloodsports lead Jackrabbits 18.9 to 10.88; ESPN projects 127.1 to 108.5, a 61% chance. No starter carries a designation; Lloyd's Friday questionable tag only firms up Jacobs' workload. The lineup is the projection lineup; nothing to do.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: Jackrabbits still have Bijan Robinson, Ashton Jeanty (at San Francisco; Mike Washington Jr. took most of Las Vegas' Week 8 carries), Burrow and McMillan to play.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: A Bloodsports starter is inactive Sunday — then the bench (Gordon 16.5, Marks 14.5, Loveland 12.1) decides and 'nothing to do' was wrong.

roster.footnote: Rows show the lineup as set at the 22:05Z snapshot. Tuten (FLEX, 8.9) and the Jaguars D/ST (10) played Thursday and are locked. Grades: StatChasers wks 1-8, upd. 4 Nov (half-PPR, 12% 2025 blend; ±1 rank), carried from this morning, not re-pulled. K and D/ST not graded.
